name: ZettaServe
summary: Perth holding/tech group (ZettaServe Pty Ltd, ACN 106 003 490, renamed Zetta Pty Ltd 2021); acquired Highway 1 in 2007; its ISP arm became Zettagrid ~2010, ending ZettaServe's role as an ISP; company continues as a non-ISP holding.

events.details: ISP arm became Zettagrid; ended as an ISP.
